Hi Soojin —

Thanks, that timeline works. A couple quick answers to your clarifying questions:
- Treat "access to customer data" broadly — include any provider that could access plaintext in production or for troubleshooting (even ephemeral access through support tools). Telemetry-only providers are still useful to list but flag them as "telemetry-only."
- For KMS, our primary ask is vendor-level defaults. If you have customer-configurable options (e.g., customer-managed keys) note that in the roster row. We may follow up for per-customer attestations for sensitive integrations.

One more: can you call out any providers that are shared with our EU cluster specifically? We have a separate data residency review team.

Regards,
Asha

- sig-responses-annotated.pdf (answers for SIG QIDs 6.1, 6.2, 7.3, 8.4 with evidence pointers)
